record.question: Which of the following medium is used for cultivation of malaria parasite :
record.explanation: Answer D: RPMI 1640 medium. RPMI 1640 is a standard basal medium for in-vitro cultivation of Plasmodium falciparum; the other named media are used for different organisms or systems. Reference: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC118084/; https://www.iddo.org/sites/default/files/publication/2023-09/INV02_PreparationOfCompleteMedium.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
